rules.description:
- **Timing:** BOMBARDMENT at the start of battle round 1; FALLOUT at the start of your Command phase in battle rounds 2, 3, 4 and 5
- **Result:**
  - BOMBARDMENT: for each enemy unit then in your opponent's deployment zone, your opponent decides whether it takes cover or stands firm; you then roll 1D6 per such unit
    - Unit Standing Firm: 3+ means D3 mortal wounds
    - Unit Taking Cover: it is battle-shocked; 5+ means D3 mortal wounds
  - FALLOUT: roll 1D6 per enemy unit in your opponent's deployment zone at that moment; on 3+ only, that unit takes 1 mortal wound and must also take a Battle-shock test
rules.name: Rad-bombardment

rules.description:
- **Timing:** start of the battle round
- **Select:** 1 of the 2 Doctrina Imperatives below (optional)
- **Result:** your army has the chosen Doctrina Imperative active; each unit in it with the Doctrina Imperatives ability gains the matching abilities
  - **PROTECTOR IMPERATIVE**
    - this unit's ranged weapons gain [HEAVY]
    - Ballistic Skill characteristic of those ranged weapons improves by 1
    - melee attack aimed at this unit: −1 to Hit roll, provided that this unit carries the ^^**Battleline**^^ keyword and/or stands ≤6" from 1+ friendly **^^Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline**^^ units
  - **CONQUEROR IMPERATIVE**
    - this unit's ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]
    - Weapon Skill characteristic of this unit's melee weapons improves by 1
    - attack by a model of this unit: Armour Penetration characteristic improves by 1, provided that this unit carries the **^^Battleline**^^ keyword and/or stands ≤6" from 1+ friendly **^^Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline**^^ units
- **Duration:** to end of the battle round
rules.name: Doctrina Imperatives

characteristics.$text:
- **Timing:** start of your Command phase
- **Select:** 1 ability listed under Canticles of the Omnissiah
- **Result:** this model gains the selected ability; the choices are
  - Invocation of Machine Vengeance (Aura): pick 1 unit of the opposing army to be your Machine Vengeance target; friendly ^^**Adeptus Mechanicus^^** models attacking that target may re-roll Hit rolls
  - Mantra of Discipline: this model also gains the ^^**Battleline**^^ keyword and **Binharic Courage (Aura)**, which affects each friendly ^^**Adeptus Mechanicus**^^ unit ≤6" away: its models get +1 Objective Control characteristic, and every Battle-shock or Leadership test you take for it gets +1
  - Shroudpsalm (Aura): each friendly **^^Adeptus Mechanicus**^^ unit ≤6" away gains the Stealth ability
- **Duration:** until your next Command phase starts, including the Machine Vengeance target
characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text:
- **Condition:** ≥1 other friendly ^^**Adeptus Mechanicus**^^ unit ≤3" from this model
- **Result:** Lone Operative ability is held by this model
characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text:
- **Timing:** Command phase of yours, at its opening
- **Result:** this model gets back lost wounds, capped at D3
characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text: When included in your army, this model is compulsorily your **^^Warlord^^**.
characteristics.name: Description

rules.description:
- **Restriction:** always expressed as **[ANTI-X Y+]**, X being a keyword
- **Result:** unmodified **wound roll** of **Y+** gives a **critical wound** when an **[ANTI]** weapon attacks a unit carrying keyword **X**
rules.name: Anti

rules.description:
- **Timing:** A **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** attack makes a **critical wound**
- **Result:**
  - Attack sequence halts
  - Target takes **mortal wounds** = weapon **D** characteristic, after regular damage
  - **Mortal wounds** from this: max 1 model damaged per **critical wound**; extra ones vanish
rules.name: Devastating Wounds

rules.description:
- **Timing:** Unit having ≥1 model with an **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon fights
- **Result:**
  - Those weapons attack alongside the models' other weapons
  - Select Weapons step, each such model must pick:
  -   - every **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon it has
  -   - 1× other melee weapon, where available
rules.name: Extra Attacks

rules.description:
- **Restriction:** **[BLAST]** weapons (or **[BLAST X]**)
- **Timing:** gathering **attack dice** for the weapon
- **Result:**
  - +1 **attack dice** per full 5 models the target unit had in the Select Targets step
  - with **[BLAST X]**: +**X** **attack dice** per full 5 models instead
rules.name: Blast

rules.description:
- **Restriction:** appears as **[MELTA X]**, on weapons
- **Timing:** a model attacks with a **[MELTA]** weapon
- **Condition:** at the Select Targets step, the chosen unit stood at no more than half of the weapon’s range
- **Result:** weapon’s **D** characteristic rises by **X**
- **Duration:** until the attacker’s attacks finish resolving
rules.name: Melta

rules.description:

- **Result:** the pair forms an **attached** unit for the whole battle

rules.name: Deadly Demise D3

rules.description:
- **Timing:** start of the battle round
- **Select:** 1 of the 2 Doctrina Imperatives below (optional)
- **Result:** your army has the chosen Doctrina Imperative active; each unit in it with the Doctrina Imperatives ability gains the matching abilities
  - **PROTECTOR IMPERATIVE**
    - this unit's ranged weapons gain [HEAVY]
    - Ballistic Skill characteristic of those ranged weapons improves by 1
    - melee attack aimed at this unit: −1 to Hit roll, provided that this unit carries the ^^**Battleline**^^ keyword and/or stands ≤6" from 1+ friendly **^^Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline**^^ units
  - **CONQUEROR IMPERATIVE**
    - this unit's ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]
    - Weapon Skill characteristic of this unit's melee weapons improves by 1
    - attack by a model of this unit: Armour Penetration characteristic improves by 1, provided that this unit carries the **^^Battleline**^^ keyword and/or stands ≤6" from 1+ friendly **^^Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline**^^ units
- **Duration:** to end of the battle round
rules.name: Doctrina Imperatives

rules.description:
- **Restriction:** **TRANSPORT** with the form **Firing Deck X**
- **Timing:** your Shooting phase, when this **TRANSPORT** is **selected to shoot**
- **Condition:** it carries 1+ embarked units
- **Select:** in order:
  - 1. up to **X** embarked models, ignoring those whose units were **selected to shoot** already this phase
  - 2. for each of them, 1× ranged weapon, never **[ONE SHOT]**
- **Result:**
  - 3. all those weapons are added to the **TRANSPORT**’s own until its attacks are all resolved
  - 4. embarked units are not eligible to shoot until end of turn
rules.name: Firing Deck 2

characteristics.$text:
- **Timing:** any Stratagem you direct at the bearer
- **Result:** 1D6 roll; on 5+ your CP total rises by 1CP
characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text:
- **Timing:** your Shooting phase, after this model shot
- **Select:** 1× enemy unit that this model hit at least once in the phase
- **Result:** friendly model that left this ^^**Transport^^** by disembarking in the turn: when attacking that enemy unit, may re-roll the Wound roll
- **Duration:** to end of the phase
characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text:
- **Restriction:** the carrier itself
- **Result:** room for 12 passengers (Transport capacity), drawn exclusively from ^^**Adeptus Mechanicus Infantry**^^ squads
  - never allowed aboard: ^^**Jump Pack, Kataphron**^^, ^^**Sydonian Skatros**^^
characteristics.name: Capacity

rules.description:
- **Restriction:** weapons only, written **[RAPID FIRE X]**
- **Timing:** gathering **attack dice** for the **[RAPID FIRE]** weapon
- **Condition:** at the Select Targets step the target was no farther than half the weapon's range
- **Result:** **X** extra **attack dice** join the pool
rules.name: Rapid Fire

rules.description:
- **Restriction:** appears as **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**, on weapons
- **Timing:** an attack with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon scores a **critical hit**
- **Result:** that attack scores **X** extra hits on its target, on top of the **critical hit** itself
rules.name: Sustained Hits

rules.description:
- **Restriction:** weapons with **[TWIN-LINKED]**
- **Result:** the **wound roll** of each attack with it may be re-rolled
rules.name: Twin-linked
